acceptance.energy_height_fit_note: the claim is that read energy is affine in column height rather than constant; a straight-line R2 above this floor establishes that, and the per-interval slopes are reported separately because they are not exactly equal

array.pattern_note: deterministic xorshift keyed by (row, column); no simulator RNG state is used
array.precharge_device_note: the precharge transistor is an official PDK model instance in the testbench, not extracted layout; every capacitance it drives is extracted

claim_boundary.boundary_of_the_measured_quantity: bit-array only: wordline, cell, bitline and precharge device. It excludes address decode, sense amplification and the macro output latch, all of which rom_read_j_per_byte's own stated boundary includes, so the measured value is a LOWER bound on the quantity that constant names.
establishes: extracted bitline capacitance per row of column height for a minimum-pitch via1-programmed NOR mask-ROM array in IHP SG13G2
the fraction of that capacitance that is coupling to the two neighbouring bitlines at the minimum legal column pitch
supply energy per read access, and per stored bit, of that exact extracted array over the declared deterministic PVT grid
that read energy per bit is affine in column height rather than constant, measured over a 16-to-128-row sweep
forbidden_inferences: N7, N6, N5 or N4 read energy, delay, leakage, bandwidth or power
that a 130 nm energy per byte may be feature-size-scaled into a target-node energy per byte
decoder, address, sense-amplifier, output-latch, repair or macro-boundary energy, none of which is in this array
statistical mismatch, sense offset, yield, aging or electromigration behaviour
whole-wafer inference throughput, device power or GPU speedup

timing.note: one precharge half-period followed by one evaluate half-period; the third cycle is measured so the array is in steady state
